lines.t: Golden skies, the morning's slow Four steps fade where soft winds blow
Worries fade like distant rain Peace returns and breaks the chain
Quiet air, the world at rest
Sunlight dances on my chest
All my striving starts to cease
Wrapped in mercy, endless peace
My heartbeat matches quiet air
I find your presence everywhere
Time stands still, I start to see
Where rest was meant to be
Take me where the still waters flow
Breathe in life, let the spirit show
Every thought begins to slow
I'm not alone, I'm finally home
Gentle light beneath the trees
Freedom found in days like these
Sacred rhythm, soft and kind
Peace and grace renew my mind
Whispers float on evening air Every sound becomes a prayer
I close my eyes, I hear you say Rest with me, the world can't wait
Here in stillness I'm made whole Quiet rivers cleanse my soul
Every heartbeat, every sigh A hallelujah passing by
No need to chase the fading sun
The week is gone, the rest begun
My soul unwinds, the shadows flee
Your love surrounds and carries
Take me where the still waters flow
Breathe in life, let the spirit show
Every thought begins to slow
I'm not alone, I'm finally home
Let the calm wash over me Like the tide that sets me free
You're the peace my heart has known I'm not alone, I'm finally home
I'm not alone, I'm finally home
I'm not alone, I'm finally home
